name: Ferrite switching transformers
summary: Small high-frequency transformers on ferrite cores from switching power supplies and inverters.
uses: Rewinding for custom converter or inverter builds
Source of ferrite cores and fine wire
identify: Small transformers with E-shaped black ferrite cores, often wrapped in yellow tape, on every switch-mode power supply, phone charger, LED driver, inverter and TV.
test: Each winding should show continuity (low ohms), with no connection between windings or to the core.
